scope: Source-only label/model/metric design; no current private scores or new private RGB used

training_sources: existing public YCB-V train_real source train
user_invariants.current_pallet_corpus: No fit, thresholds, radius, normalizer, checkpoint or model selection. Existing private output is not a v64 design/selection input.

coordinate_rule.query: unchanged registered source query; no human reference or new localization
coordinate_rule.pixel: floor(query+.5), continuous AND rounded coordinate must be inside native image
coordinate_rule.radius2: clipped5x5 square around the same nearest pixel; radius is fixed before fitting
coordinate_rule.invalid: mask all center/dense losses; do not relabel invalid positions as outside

source_mask_rules.SYNTH: visible=M4>127,full=M0>127; values1/2 are background artifacts, not target
source_mask_rules.YCB: visible=mask_visib>0,full=mask>0; verify0/255binary and subset per record
source_mask_rules.subset: visible must be subset of full or the record fails the mask contract

radius2: VISIBLE if any visible pixel in the fixed clipped window
else EXTERNAL_SUPPORT if any full pixel in window
label_rules.mixed_window: Visible has priority for the window-support target; save visible/full/hidden counts and mixed support attributes.
label_rules.external_definition: Full target-only silhouette support removed by final scene visibility. It is a source mask-difference target, not guaranteed human corner external occlusion.
label_rules.outside_definition: No target support at this scale; includes background, holes or wrong query. Do not rename it external occlusion.
label_rules.semantic_self: UNKNOWN: hidden semantic 3D corners can project onto visible target-owned surfaces; full/visible2D masks supply no native-corner self truth.

external_evidence.role: Attributes and stratified evaluation only, never relabel EXTERNAL_SUPPORT as OUTSIDE or invent self.
external_evidence.other_visible: Union source-visible masks of all other instances in the frame, excluding target. Positive overlap on hidden target support is explicit source ownership evidence; retain overlap count and coverage.
external_evidence.depth: Only aligned scene and target-render depth in the same units plus an explicitly locked source tolerance can establish scene surface in front of target. Measured depth>0, object-center z or frame valid-pixel totals alone cannot.
external_evidence.render_boundary: Mark mask transition/image clipping without other-owner or paired-depth evidence as ambiguous render boundary. An uncertainty attribute is not proof that the source label is wrong.
external_evidence.unknown: Missing other-instance masks or target-render depth stays unavailable; no automatic negative or fabricated depth evidence.
external_evidence.conflict: Preserve source class and flag paired scene-depth-behind conflict for audit.

training.head: one6-way joint softmax; no impossible joint training labels
training.loss: source-domain-balanced mean center joint cross entropy +0.25 source-domain-balanced valid dense joint cross entropy
training.evidence_weights: 1forall including ambiguous boundaries; confidence attributes do not silently remove hard source cases
training.reason: First registered intervention isolates multitarget/representation changes; inverse-frequency weights would additionally change calibrated source-prior behavior.
training.optional_later_control: If needed, register a separate run using inverse TRAIN joint frequencies per domain, clipped before normalization. Never compute weights from VAL/private or retrofit the primary.
training.budget: Root registered fixed2000updates; checkpoint selected only by source validation

selection.primary: unweighted center jointNLL per domain, then equal mean over SYNTH andYCB; strict lowest value; no private choice
baselines: TRAIN-only per-domain empirical6joint prior (actual trainer baseline)
TRAIN-only per-domain6joint prior with Laplace1 (additional diagnostic)
frozen rawSAM exact/r2 visible plus prompt-box full-support heuristic
selection.prior_rule: Primary empirical TRAIN prior count_j/TRAINtotal matches frozen trainer; additional Laplace1=(count_j+1)/(TRAINtotal+6). For a missing TRAIN domain use global TRAIN prior and disclose.
audit: Report each domain separately; a good macro mean can hide a failed domain.
Report jointNLL/Brier and6stateMAPconfusion; exact/radius2 V/E/O hierarchical confusion,P/R and balanced accuracy; binary visible/full BCE/AP.
Report external-support confirmedother/depth versus ambiguousboundary strata with their full denominators.

Constant all-absent cannot claim success from recall or accuracy. If a supported class has zero recall or a domain does not beat its TRAIN-prior NLL, mark a source mechanism HOLD diagnostic; do not silently switch metrics or thresholds.
selection.thresholds: Primary binary visible pV>=.5; user-facing mechanism jointMAP with maxjoint>=.5 else wholepairU; logical pV/pFull .5 paired diagnostic. All fixed before private.

outputs.near_visible_without_exact_visible: p1+p3; finite spatial evidence change, not verified coordinate error
outputs.joint_MAP: Argmax p0..p5 is a six-state MAP diagnostic; user-facing mechanism additionally requires maxjoint>=.5.
outputs.independent_marginal_argmax: Do not combine independent3classargmax predictions as a physically valid pair; explicit counterexample preserved.
outputs.confidence_U: User-facing mechanism: accept jointMAP only ifmaxjoint>=.5, otherwise entirepairU. Exact .5 ties accepted, argmax firstindex. Report coverage and recallallGT including U; no fitted threshold.
outputs.probability_caution: Ehardcall need not imply pE>=.5, and softmax confidence is not calibrated on current pallet data.
outputs.primary_binary_comparison: pVisible>=.5 at each scale, same visible-versus-nonvisible threshold as v61/v63; no U in binary comparison.
outputs.logical_support_diagnostic: At each scale V ifpVisible>=.5; elseE ifpFull>=.5; elseO. Paired6validstates with nested sums; logical E may have pE<.5, so not mechanism confidence.

interpreting_joint_states.0: Exact query target visible, with local visible support.
interpreting_joint_states.1: Exact supported pixel is hidden while a nearby pixel has visible support; evidence varies within2px.
interpreting_joint_states.2: Exact and nearby supported region have no visible target pixels.
interpreting_joint_states.3: Exact query lies outside target support while target is visible nearby; potential query phase/boundary mismatch, not semantic location-error truth.
interpreting_joint_states.4: Exact query outside support, with hidden target support nearby.
interpreting_joint_states.5: No target support at exact or radius2window.

geometry: Optional saved-initial-pose cuboid self flag remains separate from raw joint probabilities; never a learned target, no pose solve or reference-coordinate input.

protocol_amendment.reason: Clarify distinction between binary visibility comparison, logical support diagnostic, and confidence-qualified user-facing mechanism before any v64 private inference. No loss/data/checkpoint/radius/threshold changes.
protocol_amendment.confidence_limitation: Joint confidence requires confidence about both exact and nearby states. E marginal may be substantial but split between EV andEE; output explicit per-scale pE, preserve U recallallGT and per-class coverage.
protocol_amendment.independent_validation: 1,000,000 generated posteriors and11ties; acceptedjointMAP chosen exact/near marginals >=.5.
